family_reports.body: The system has caused a severe amount of trauma to my entire family. especially my daughter they came in and took my daughter away from a perfectly safe home perfectly safe parent and placed her with a rapist she was raped at gunpoint for 3 months sometimes several times each day
The system is trying to destroy my family for profit. Evil tyrants need to be stopped.
CPS and all related agencies need to be abolished for destroying American families for no just reason.
They are trying to destroy my family for no reason just so they can have a kid for the federal funds.

The Jefferson County Court system under Edward Page had created fear of speaking out for truth and transparency while fighting for the safety and well-being of my infant child by dismissing drug use, domestic violence and proven false testimonies.
